description: Audited Surface Pro 11 userspace and firmware components. Support actions describe bounded linux-armer capabilities; they are data flags, not executable instructions.

components.name: FullIO v19c Audio Topology and UCM

kernel_compatibility.summary: FullIO audio requires the interfaces introduced by the sp11v12 kernel generation and remains validated through sp11v19.

notes: The topology and UCM set is validated with the geocausa v12 kernel generation and must remain a coherent release.
The topology contains protected vendor-derived bytes and remains behind an explicit redistribution boundary.
components.remediation: Install the complete hash-verified release with its paired kernel generation, and replace the complete set if any member differs.

components.name: WCN7850 Bluetooth Public Address Integration
notes: The bounded raw management-socket helper applies the Windows-sourced public controller address before BlueZ initialises.
Cold-boot initialisation and pairing passed on the audited X1E device; audio and suspend coverage remains incomplete.
components.remediation: Confirm the controller address from the same device, rebuild the bounded helper when its source changes, reinstall its lifecycle integration, and cold boot.

components.name: Surface Pro 11 Platform Firmware
notes: Qualcomm platform, GPU, audio DSP, camera, and wireless firmware is required before the related devices can initialise.
Windows-derived firmware remains outside distributable linux-armer artefacts unless redistribution rights are confirmed.
components.remediation: Acquire firmware from an authorised source, verify that it belongs to the target device, and rerun component status checks.

components.name: G6 HEAT Pen Processor
notes: The evidence-gated HEAT processor is retained for controlled capture and deterministic replay only.
Production pen input is superseded by the pinned iptsd integration, and both processors must never run concurrently.
components.remediation: Keep the diagnostic service disabled outside controlled capture or replay work, and use the supported iptsd integration for production pen input.

components.name: IMX681 libcamera Simple IPA Package Set

kernel_compatibility.summary: IMX681 camera support requires the interfaces introduced by the sp11v14 kernel generation and remains experimentally assessed through sp11v19.

notes: The five runtime packages, same-build IPA signature, provenance records, and checksum manifest form one exact set paired with the v14 camera kernel generation.
Processed browser video passed, while automatic exposure, final calibration, privacy behaviour, and suspend resilience remain experimental gates.
components.remediation: Install every allowlisted runtime package from one verified release with its paired kernel, and reject mixed package generations.

components.name: Pinned iptsd v3.1.0 SP11 Integration

kernel_compatibility.summary: The pinned IPTSD integration requires the Surface HIDRAW bridge delivered by the sp11v19 kernel generation.

notes: Unmodified upstream iptsd v3.1.0 is pinned with complete corresponding source and an SP11-specific lifecycle integration.
X1E Phase 84 pen validation passed with the v19 kernel generation; separate X1P and broader lifecycle qualification remain.
components.remediation: Rebuild the pinned payload with complete corresponding sources, validate its checksum manifest, disable conflicting pen processors, and reinstall the matched lifecycle set.

components.name: Out-of-Tree Touchscreen Modules
notes: The geocausa out-of-tree module workflow was superseded by the hardware-verified in-tree touchscreen stack.
Retaining stale modules can create ABI disagreement and initramfs contamination after a kernel upgrade.
components.remediation: Use reversible clean-up only for its recognised fixed configuration hooks. Manually review reported exact-ABI module overrides, release markers, package diversions, and initramfs contamination before using current in-tree touchscreen support.

components.name: Surface Platform Power Profiles
notes: The non-ACPI platform-profile framework fix is integrated in the kernel and works with the distribution power-profiles daemon unchanged.
Low-power, balanced, balanced-performance, and performance switching passed on the audited X1E device.
components.remediation: Boot a kernel containing the non-ACPI platform-profile integration and verify that the distribution daemon binds the platform profile driver.

components.name: WCN7850 Wi-Fi Integration
notes: WCN7850 uses the in-kernel ath12k driver, validated firmware and board data, and Denali device-tree rfkill handling.
Scanning, association, traffic, and reconnect passed; repeated suspend and broader upgrade coverage remains.
components.remediation: Install validated firmware and board data, boot an integrated kernel, and cold boot before reassessing radio state.
